newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel PM, Treasury to meet to discuss budget cut.
newsitem.headline: Israel PM, Treasury to meet to discuss budget cut.

text.p: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will meet on Friday with Finance Minister Dan Meridor and senior treasury officials to discuss further possible cuts in the budget, the Treasury said on Thursday.
It is not known if any decision will be taken.
The 1997 budget of 197 billion shekels already includes a seven billion shekel cut. Treasury officials believe another one billion shekel cut may be needed to meet the deficit target.
The central bank has also called for spending cuts to guarantee the government will meet its deficit target for this year of 2.8 percent of gross domestic product.
